text.description_html:
First Impressions SQDP/18-US32D 18 Inch Modern Square Stainless Steel Refrigerator Pull

Very modern designed 18" refrigerator door pull made of 5/8" square solid stainless steel by First Impressions, a leader manufacture in appliance door pulls. Warm Satin Stainless Steel finish for a truly eye catching modern appearance. They requiring little maintenance, designed to enhance any setting where a modern, clean look is desired.

Also available: Longer 24" Modern Square Stainless Refrigerator Pull and matching Square Stainless Cabinet Pulls

Specifications for First Impressions SQDP/18-US32D Modern Stainless Steel Appliance Pull

  • Total Height: 18"
  • Mounting Centers: 12" C/C (distance between the 2 mounting holes)
  • Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Diameter: 5/8" Square
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel

Note: This appliance handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 6 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the appliance handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with mounting screws for a standard 3/4" - 1" thick refrigerator/appliance door panel.

*Sold individually.
